svg.title: Lines of descent in Iradi popular music, 1985–2026
svg.desc: Timeline chart of Iradi music genres and acts from 1985 to 2026 in seven lines of descent, with arrows showing which grew from or was influenced by which.
svg.text: Lines of descent in Iradi popular music, 1985–2026
Genres, scenes and leading acts by the year they began. Roots are on the left; a box sits in the line it mainly belongs to.
